description: The Java toolkit is an implementation of cryptographic functions accessible by an object-oriented API. Depending on configuration, the algorithms may be implemented in software, hardware, or both. The industry standard Cryptopki API from PKCS #11, is used as the interface to hardware-based cryptographic modules.
